_comment: Drukhari army rules + faction-specific citations (10e). Wave 246: Power From Pain is now fully modelled as an army-level token pool (army.pain_token_pool). Accrual: +1 at start of own Command phase, +1 per enemy unit destroyed, +1 per enemy unit failing a Battle-shock test. Spend: greedy AI elects the highest-DPA Drukhari unit per round and grants transient_lethal_hits (APPROXIMATION — the codex activates per-datasheet Pain abilities; the simulator collapses Empowering to Lethal Hits as the dominant offensive uplift). Gated SWEG_PAIN_TOKENS (default ON since the wave-246 close adoption; =0 kill-switch). The obsolete per-unit pain_tokens field and the Below-Starting-Strength per-unit accrual block have been removed.

simulator.power_from_pain.source: https://github.com/BSData/wh40k-10e/blob/main/Aeldari%20-%20Aeldari%20Library.cat (rule 'Power from Pain' id 5e02-2ddc-f55-e6dd; verified verbatim from local cache data/bsdata/cache/Aeldari - Aeldari Library.cat.gz — Wahapedia unreachable at implementation time)
simulator.power_from_pain.quoted_text: All DRUKHARI units have a Pain ability, tagged with the word 'Pain'. Pain abilities only apply to a unit while it is Empowered. If your Army Faction is DRUKHARI, you can Empower units from your army with Pain abilities by spending Pain tokens (see below). GAINING PAIN TOKENS: If your Army Faction is DRUKHARI, you gain Pain tokens as follows: 1 Pain token at the start of your Command phase. 1 Pain token each time an enemy unit is destroyed. 1 Pain token each time an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test. Each time you gain a Pain token, keep it to one side – this is your Pain token pool. Each time you spend a Pain token, reduce your Pain token pool by the same amount. EMPOWERED THROUGH PAIN: Each Pain ability will state when you can spend Pain tokens to Empower that unit. When you do, until the end of the phase, that unit is Empowered and all Pain abilities it has take effect. While an Attached unit is Empowered, the Pain abilities of all Leader and Bodyguard units in that unit take effect - you do not need to spend additional Pain tokens to activate each of those Pain abilities.
simulator.power_from_pain.trigger: army.pain_token_pool >= 1 when a Drukhari unit is selected to shoot or fight; greedy AI spends 1 token on the highest-DPA Drukhari unit per round via _apply_power_from_pain_spend. Pool accrual: see sub-citations .command_phase_accrual, .enemy_destroyed_accrual, .battleshock_accrual. Gated SWEG_PAIN_TOKENS (default ON since the wave-246 close adoption; =0 kill-switch).
simulator.power_from_pain.effect: APPROXIMATION: grants transient_lethal_hits to the elected unit for the round via _set_transient_squad. The codex activates per-datasheet Pain abilities on the Empowered unit; SwegHammer collapses this to Lethal Hits as the dominant offensive uplift. Attached/multi-instance squads spend ONCE (dedup via _unit_budget_used keyed on squad_id). Pool decremented by 1 per spend.

simulator.power_from_pain.command_phase_.quoted_text: 1 Pain token at the start of your Command phase.
simulator.power_from_pain.command_phase_.trigger: start of own Command phase (Battle._run_round command-phase block) if at least one alive Drukhari unit is in the army; gated SWEG_PAIN_TOKENS

simulator.power_from_pain.enemy_destroye.quoted_text: 1 Pain token each time an enemy unit is destroyed.
simulator.power_from_pain.enemy_destroye.trigger: last model of an enemy codex unit is destroyed (last-instance gate via squad_id / profile.name, mirroring _maybe_award_blood_tithe template) and the killer army contains at least one alive Drukhari unit; fired from _maybe_award_pain_token at the 4 kill sites (shooting, melee, Tank Shock, Counter-Offensive); gated SWEG_PAIN_TOKENS

simulator.power_from_pain.battleshock_ac.quoted_text: 1 Pain token each time an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
simulator.power_from_pain.battleshock_ac.trigger: an enemy codex unit fails its Battle-shock test (roll < target branch in _battleshock_test_squad, once per squad roll — the per-squad emit maps to one codex unit) and the opposing army contains at least one alive Drukhari unit; gated SWEG_PAIN_TOKENS

simulator.power_from_pain.pfp_embarked_f.rule_name: Power From Pain — AI targeting improvement (embarked-unit filter)
simulator.power_from_pain.pfp_embarked_f.quoted_text: Each Pain ability will state when you can spend Pain tokens to Empower that unit. When you do, until the end of the phase, that unit is Empowered and all Pain abilities it has take effect.
simulator.power_from_pain.pfp_embarked_f.trigger: SWEG_DRUKHARI_PFP_EMBARKED=1 (default OFF, wave 249); fires inside _apply_power_from_pain_spend when the gate is ON, filtering the drukhari_units candidate list to exclude units whose embarked_in is not None
simulator.power_from_pain.pfp_embarked_f.effect: AI play-quality improvement only — NOT a change to the codex rule. The Power From Pain codex rule does not restrict which unit may be Empowered; this filter embodies competent play (a player never spends an Empower token on a unit that cannot act this round because it is inside a transport). When OFF the spend considers all alive Drukhari units including embarked passengers, which can waste the buff. This strictly improves the AI's token economy without pulling any unit back or playing more passively.

simulator.power_from_pain.pfp_multispend.rule_name: Power From Pain — multi-unit Empower (no per-phase cap)
simulator.power_from_pain.pfp_multispend.quoted_text: Each Pain ability will state when you can spend Pain tokens to Empower that unit. When you do, until the end of the phase, that unit is Empowered and all Pain abilities it has take effect. While an Attached unit is Empowered, the Pain abilities of all Leader and Bodyguard units in that unit take effect — you do not need to spend additional Pain tokens to activate each of those Pain abilities. Each time you spend a Pain token, reduce your Pain token pool by the same amount.
simulator.power_from_pain.pfp_multispend.trigger: SWEG_DRUKHARI_PFP_MULTISPEND (adopted default-on, wave 258; =0 kill-switch); inside _apply_power_from_pain_spend, while army.pain_token_pool > 0 Empower the next-best-DPA eligible Drukhari unit (one token each, per-codex-unit-per-round dedup via unit_budget_available)
simulator.power_from_pain.pfp_multispend.effect: Removes the wave-246 single-spend cap; each Empower grants the appropriate Pain ability to the squad (per datasheet if SWEG_DRUKHARI_PFP_PERDATASHEET=1, else transient_lethal_hits) and decrements the pool by 1. The Cronos Pain Engine aura may refund tokens (see simulator.cronos_pain_engine). All new RNG is inside the ON path only; OFF path is byte-identical to wave 246.

simulator.cronos_pain_engine.quoted_text: Each time you spend 1 Pain token to Empower a friendly unit within 9" of this unit, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if one or more models in this unit are not equipped with a spirit vortex: on a 5+, you gain 1 Pain token.
simulator.cronos_pain_engine.trigger: SWEG_DRUKHARI_PFP_MULTISPEND (adopted default-on, wave 258; =0 kill-switch); inside _apply_power_from_pain_spend, each time a Drukhari unit within 9 inches of an alive friendly Cronos is Empowered (a Pain token is spent on it)
simulator.cronos_pain_engine.effect: Roll 1 D6 + 1 (the catalogue Cronos carries no spirit vortex loadout, so the +1 always applies); on a 5+ refund 1 Pain token to the army (army.pain_token_pool += 1), partially recouping the multi-spend cost. The D6 draw only occurs inside the SWEG_DRUKHARI_PFP_MULTISPEND=1 ON path; the OFF path is byte-identical.

simulator.power_from_pain.per_datasheet.rule_name: Power From Pain — per-datasheet Pain abilities (Hatred Eternal, Sadistic Raiders, Decapitating Strikes, Brides of Death, Experimental Enhancements, Agonising Suppression)
simulator.power_from_pain.per_datasheet.quoted_text: Hatred Eternal (Archon): 'While that unit is Empowered, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.' Sadistic Raiders (Kabalite Warriors): 'While that unit is Empowered, each time a model in this unit makes an attack, you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If the target is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.' Decapitating Strikes (Incubi): 'While Empowered, each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets an INFANTRY unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.' Brides of Death (Lelith Hesperax): 'While that unit is Empowered, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.' Experimental Enhancements (Wracks): 'While Empowered ... melee weapons equipped by non-CHARACTER models in this unit have an Attacks characteristic of 3 [or 4 and the [HAZARDOUS] ability].' Agonising Suppression (Ravager): 'While Empowered, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks ... that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.'
simulator.power_from_pain.per_datasheet.trigger: SWEG_DRUKHARI_PFP_PERDATASHEET (adopted default-on, wave 258; =0 kill-switch); a Drukhari unit is Empowered via _apply_power_from_pain_spend (1 Pain token spent), and _grant_pain_ability routes by profile.name to the unit's printed Pain ability
simulator.power_from_pain.per_datasheet.effect: Archon -> transient_reroll_all_hits (full Hit re-roll). Kabalite Warriors -> transient_reroll_wounds_ones (re-roll Wound rolls of 1; the conditional near-objective full-wound-reroll upgrade is conservatively omitted, modelling only the always-on leg). Incubi -> transient_devastating_wounds_vs_infantry (melee [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] vs INFANTRY targets only). Lelith Hesperax -> transient_brides_of_death (+1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration on melee attacks). Wracks -> transient_set_melee_attacks=3 (SET non-character melee Attacks to 3; the +1/HAZARDOUS=4 leg omitted as a conservative simplification). Ravager 'Agonising Suppression' (-1 to Hit debuff on a hit enemy unit until next turn) is NOT modelled this wave — falls back to transient_lethal_hits. All non-mapped Drukhari datasheets fall back to transient_lethal_hits so no Empower is wasted.

simulator.skysplinter_rain_of_cruelty.quoted_text: Each time a DRUKHARI unit from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LANCE] ability.
simulator.skysplinter_rain_of_cruelty.trigger: a DRUKHARI unit disembarks from a TRANSPORT (voluntary disembark in own Movement phase OR forced disembark when the transport is destroyed) AND the army's detachment is Skysplinter Assault
simulator.skysplinter_rain_of_cruelty.effect: until the next round-start the disembarked unit's `transient_lance_this_turn` and `transient_ignores_cover_this_turn` flags are True. The LANCE flag composes via OR with `profile.lance` at the lance eligibility gate in Unit.attack (still gated on `is_charging` because LANCE itself only fires when this attack is made on the turn the bearer's unit declared a charge). The IGNORES COVER flag composes via OR with `profile.ignores_cover` at the ranged ignore_cover gate so the target's Benefits of Cover save bonus and the in_heavy_cover -1 to hit are bypassed for the disembark turn. Melee mode already ignores cover unconditionally so the IGNORES COVER half is a no-op on the melee branch. Flags cleared at the next round-start by `simulator._clear_transient_stratagem_flags`, matching the 'until the end of the turn' wording. Applies to both voluntary disembark (own Movement phase) and forced disembark (destroyed transport) — the codex wording does not exclude the destroyed-transport disembark from the rule.
